description.narrative:
In the ‘UNConventionAlly’ project, is in the strategic framework beyond20 and reflects the changing international context. It aims to ensure that the unprecedented opportunity of the UN tax convention is fully seized. TJN will also contribute to support ambitious progressive proposals for climate finance that align with tax justice principles. Each of 4 major workstreams contribute to the achievement of our global objective. Workstream 1 encompasses the high-quality research TJN produces to support its own advocacy efforts but also to inform and support the work of others with key data, research and tools, and global dissemination efforts targeted to media and civil society including from the Global South and Africa in particular.
Workstream 2 covers advocacy to, and technical collaboration with national governments. Advocacy will focus on ensuring that the UN Convention currently being drafted is fully ambitious and is actually delivered, while collaboration with national tax authorities and associated governmental bodies will carry on being implemented in partnership with local civil society actors and will remain heavily focused on supporting national authorities from the Global South including Africa.
Workstream 3 focuses on the narrative shift we are aiming for under our beyond20 strategy, strengthening our communication efforts and global media reach, including through the provision of targeted journalist training to build capacity to engage with the UN convention and national policy decisions.
